scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof given with necessary moment equations, Vandermonde algebraicity, classical Hermite-Lindemann theorem, positive Gaussian quadrature construction, and explicit unproved limits. Finite checker provides supplementary exact polynomial identities only.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite equal-external-weight, full-Fock Gaussian-compensated sampling of polynomial degrees n=2m-1 >=3. Proves at least m+1 distinct radii, not existence at m+1, and establishes the exact positive-variable-weight minimum m. No quantitative near-tight gap, even-degree classification, or minimal individual sample count. Best-knowledge literature comparison does not certify worldwide priority.
title: An arithmetic radial-shell obstruction for equal-weight finite Fock frames
